{{Top|leg}}
'''Poltroop-seed oil''' was a byproduct of the [[poltroop]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]]. [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] used the oil to create lamps by filling a bowl with the substance covered by a lid. A wick was then extended through the lid, allowing a flame to be produced.<ref name="MS">{{JournalCite|14|Murder in Slushtime}}</ref>
